description: Discovery index for project intelligence views. A Naya (or her worker) reads this file to discover what project intelligence is available, where it lives, and how fresh it is. This is the front door — not the intelligence itself.

how_to_use.for_human: This is the table of contents. The project_intelligence view is the one-page-everything for each project.
how_to_use.for_naya: Read this manifest first. Pick the project you need. For machine-actionable instructions, read the machine_core. For human context, read the project_intelligence view. For the plan, read the execution_plan. For the charter, read the charter.
how_to_use.freshness: This manifest is updated when project views are added, removed, or significantly restructured. Individual views carry their own last-verified timestamps.

projects.mission: Assemble the complete learning system so Naya demonstrably learns, retains, and grows. Smart note in → she understands → she learns → behavior changes.

system_truth.description: Deep diagnostic companion to the canonical Learning Engine Assembly Blueprint. Evidence-tagged system truth, gap inventory, detailed work orders.

views.description: The organized mind of the Activation Naya project: identity, current state, plan, active work, decisions, lessons, open questions, blockers, evidence.
Master project charter: mission in four tongues, 8 success criteria, 5 prioritized phases, scorecard, operating principles.
Team consensus execution plan: 7 sections in order, work orders WO0-WO10, scorecard (Alt E 7.80), 26 holes resolved, dependency map, acceptance criteria for ACTIVATED.

Machine-readable activation core v2.0: mission, 9 merged nodes, learning chain + lifecycle, connections, 14 work orders, phased plan, 40 laws (26 standing + 14 operational), gaps, glossary, activation test. A cold agent reads this file to know what to build, in what order, and how to verify each piece.
Complete build manual: 9 nodes, learning lifecycle, connected state, missing connections, connection plan, acceptance criteria, visual maps.

reconciliation_note: v2 reconciles PR #2052 (.naya/project-intelligence/) and PR #2054 (BRAIN/ locations) into one canonical set. All paths below are canonical. The .naya/project-intelligence/ directory now contains only a README pointing here.

templates.description: The canonical template every project uses for its project intelligence. 9 human-readable sections + machine-verifiable entry IDs + living mechanism. v2 reconciles the PR #2052 and PR #2054 templates.
